'''The Mighty Musstoro''' was a hulking [[Ankura/Legends|Ankura]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] street wrestler operating in the [[Center Sphere District]] of [[Bartyn's Landing]], [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]] as of c. [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]]. Using a street barker as his representative, the Mighty Musstoro challenged bystanders to a test of strength, with bets. Anyone defeating The Mighty Musstoro was entitled to 100 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
